name: 17236 · Mercersburg, PA
findings: ZIP 17236 (Mercersburg) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17236 (Mercersburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17236 (Mercersburg) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
